name: qgc-greenfield
description: Electron + Rust scaffold for the QGroundControl rewrite

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts && npm run copy:renderer
scripts.build:native: npm exec -- napi build --platform --release --manifest-path rust-core/Cargo.toml --output-dir rust-core
scripts.dev: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts && npm run copy:renderer && electron .
